name: @polyspec/crudui-generator-svelte
description: Svelte form builder component library based on crudui YAML definitions

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/package-dist.mts build 'npm exec --prefix tools -- svelte-package -i src -o "$CRUDUI_DIST"'
scripts.test: status=0; node ../../tests/conformance/run-suite.mts vitest --cwd packages/svelte || status=1; node ../../tests/conformance/run-suite.mts vitest --cwd packages/svelte --config vitest.client.config.ts || status=1; exit $status
scripts.lint: npm exec --prefix tools -- eslint --config tools/eslint.config.js src
